answer: One concrete defense is per-identity bonded stake tied to verifiable work history. To register, an agent must lock capital it forfeits if cluster analysis links it to another identity through matching timing, shared funding, or near-duplicate outputs. Each extra identity therefore costs real, slashable money, and coordinated accounts trace a revealable spiral of shared fingerprints. Honest peers attest only identities whose stake and record survive audit, and a raven can no more fake a crystal ledger entry than conjure the bond behind it.
